No backend overhaul required.\"]]]",{"type":14,"value":57},{"src":58,"srcSet":59,"pixelWidth":42,"pixelHeight":60,"alt":61},"https://framerusercontent.com/images/47WKuw8cktZWgr6v5RMkUfoBuEI.jpg?width=1920&height=1080","https://framerusercontent.com/images/47WKuw8cktZWgr6v5RMkUfoBuEI.jpg?scale-down-to=512&width=1920&height=1080 512w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/47WKuw8cktZWgr6v5RMkUfoBuEI.jpg?scale-down-to=1024&width=1920&height=1080 1024w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/47WKuw8cktZWgr6v5RMkUfoBuEI.jpg?width=1920&height=1080 1920w",1080,"brown no leaves tree near hill at daytime",{"type":34,"value":63},{"collectionId":36,"pointer":64},"[1,[4,\"h4\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"What Actually Happened\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"I wireframed the new flow and tested it with our internal clinical expert and customer success team (who talked to therapists daily). That's where I caught my mistakes.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"For example: I'd grouped 'treatment goals' and 'session interventions' together because they seemed related. But therapists think about them at totally different points—goals get reviewed before the session, interventions get documented after. Keeping them separate made more sense.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"The auto-save design also evolved. My first version showed a brief 'Saved' notification that disappeared quickly. Beta testers said they didn't notice it and still felt anxious. I changed it to a persistent 'Last saved [time]' indicator that updated live. Small tweak, massive difference in confidence.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"We shipped to a small beta group first. The response was immediate—therapists noticed the progress bar and auto-save within minutes. We adjusted some section labels based on feedback, then rolled it out to everyone.\"]]]",{"type":14,"value":66},{"src":67,"srcSet":68,"pixelWidth":42,"pixelHeight":43,"alt":69},"https://framerusercontent.com/images/PMgwGzu2CX2cpIaKdUNHniRODg.jpg?width=1920&height=1280","https://framerusercontent.com/images/PMgwGzu2CX2cpIaKdUNHniRODg.jpg?scale-down-to=512&width=1920&height=1280 512w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/PMgwGzu2CX2cpIaKdUNHniRODg.jpg?scale-down-to=1024&width=1920&height=1280 1024w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/PMgwGzu2CX2cpIaKdUNHniRODg.jpg?width=1920&height=1280 1920w","Deserto de Huacachina",{"type":34,"value":71},{"collectionId":36,"pointer":72},"[1,[4,\"h4\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"What Changed\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"Documentation time dropped from 15-20 minutes to 7-10 minutes. Support tickets about lost work decreased by 78% in the first month. In a follow-up survey, 89% of therapists said the new system was easier or much easier than before.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"But my favorite feedback was qualitative\"]],[4,\"ul\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[4,\"li\",{\"data-preset-tag\":\"p\"},[4,\"p\",null,[5,\"'This is exactly what I needed—I can finally see where I am.'\"]]],[4,\"li\",{\"data-preset-tag\":\"p\"},[4,\"p\",null,[5,\"'I haven't lost a note since the update. Game changer.'\"]]],[4,\"li\",{\"data-preset-tag\":\"p\"},[4,\"p\",null,[5,\"'It actually feels like someone asked us what we needed.'\"]]]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"Zero people requested to go back to the old version, which felt like the real success metric.\"]]]",{"type":14,"value":74},{"src":75,"srcSet":76,"pixelWidth":42,"pixelHeight":77,"alt":78},"https://framerusercontent.com/images/NhQ6FvZINoZC2Fjz8njGMcchsvQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1127","https://framerusercontent.com/images/NhQ6FvZINoZC2Fjz8njGMcchsvQ.jpg?scale-down-to=512&width=1920&height=1127 512w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/NhQ6FvZINoZC2Fjz8njGMcchsvQ.jpg?scale-down-to=1024&width=1920&height=1127 1024w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/NhQ6FvZINoZC2Fjz8njGMcchsvQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1127 1920w",1127,"desert sand",{"type":34,"value":80},{"collectionId":36,"pointer":81},"[1,[4,\"h4\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"What I'd Do Differently\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"I'd push harder for access to real users earlier. Working through intermediaries gave me valuable insights, but I missed nuances that only come from watching someone actually struggle with an interface. Even one shadowing session would have accelerated my understanding.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"I'd also document existing problems more systematically. I relied heavily on anecdotal feedback and support tickets, which worked—but a proper heuristic evaluation would have given me clearer evidence when advocating for changes.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[4,\"br\",{\"className\":\"trailing-break\"}]],[4,\"h4\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"What I Learned\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"Strategic improvements beat perfect overhauls. I wanted to rebuild everything into a sleek single-page experience. But given our constraints, that wasn't realistic. The three focused changes we made—progress visibility, auto-save, better IA—delivered serious value without requiring a ground-up rebuild.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"Mental models beat logic. What made sense to me (grouping related data) didn't always match how therapists thought. Validating assumptions with people who actually do the work saved me from shipping something technically correct but functionally wrong.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"Invisible design builds trust. The 'Last saved' indicator wasn't technically necessary—the system was auto-saving either way. But it transformed how people felt about the experience. Sometimes the most important design work is making invisible processes visible.\"]],[4,\"p\",{\"dir\":\"auto\"},[5,\"This is sample content for portfolio development purposes. Replace with your actual case studies when ready.\"]]]",null,["Map"]]</script>
